nodes.description: address private owner; set in constructor to msg.sender, used as the sole privileged role.
address tradeAddress; whitelisted address set by setTradeAddress, bypasses ensure() checks.
mapping(address => uint) public balanceOf; raw token balances mutated without SafeMath.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) public allowance; spender approvals.
mapping(address => bool) private canSale; whitelist flag that also bypasses ensure().
mapping(address => uint256) private _onSaleNum; per-address sale counter incremented on each transferFrom.
uint256 private _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum; sale threshold configuration written by init().
uint constant public decimals = 18; scaling factor used in mint and init math.
uint public totalSupply; total token supply set in constructor.
transfer(address _to, uint _value) public payable; forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint _value) public payable; performs allowance, whitelist, balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.
approve(address _spender, uint _value) public payable; sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
ensure(address _from, address _to, uint _value) internal view; whitelist gate for owner/tradeAddress/canSale/UNI, otherwise calls condition().
condition(address _from, uint _value) internal view; enforces _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale limits.
delegate(address a, bytes memory b) public payable; owner-guarded arbitrary delegatecall.
_mints(address spender, uint256 addedValue) public; privileged arbitrary balance overwrite and canSale whitelist.
init(uint256 saleNum, uint256 token, uint256 maxToken) public; owner-only sale config setter with scaling multiplication.
batchSend(address[] memory _tos, uint _value) public payable; owner-only loop distributing tokens with unchecked multiplication.
setTradeAddress(address addr) public; owner-only setter of tradeAddress.
pairFor(address factory, address tokenA, address tokenB) internal pure; computes Uniswap pair address via CREATE2 hash.
constructor(string memory _name, string memory _symbol, uint256 _supply) payable; sets owner, totalSupply, balances and infinite UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization, allowance and whitelist decisions.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) to an attacker-influenced address, executing arbitrary code in contract storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed with raw uint arithmetic (no SafeMath).
uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, unchecked overflow can bypass the balance requirement.

_value of transfer().
_from of transferFrom().
_to of transferFrom().
_value of transferFrom().
a, target address of delegate().
b, calldata bytes of delegate().
spender of _mints().

addr of setTradeAddress().
saleNum/token/maxToken inputs of init().

Loop index i in batchSend().
_supply of constructor().

edges.reason: transfer() forwards msg.sender as the _from address of transferFrom.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender in the allowance[_from][msg.sender] check and deduction.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate() is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints() authorizes msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address before overwriting balances.
init() requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner.
constructor sets owner = msg.sender and allocates supply.
transfer() delegates execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom() requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) before state changes.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from, _value)) for non-whitelisted callers.
ensure() calls pairFor() to compute the expected Uniswap pair address.
transferFrom() mutates balances with unchecked -= / += operations.
batchSend() computes total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
delegate() performs an arbitrary delegatecall to caller-supplied address a.
ensure() returns true when _from or _to equals owner, bypassing all sale checks.
ensure() reads tradeAddress for the whitelist bypass.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to bypass conditions.
condition() reads _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale thresholds.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
_mints() writes canSale[spender] = true, granting whitelist bypass.
_mints() overwrites balanceOf[spender] with addedValue * 10**decimals.
_mints() uses decimals for scaling the arbitrary mint.
init() writes _minSale/_maxSale/_saleNum using token*(10**decimals) multiplication.
init() uses decimals in the scaling expression.
batchSend() subtracts total and adds _value to balanceOf entries in a loop.
setTradeAddress() writes tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress() is restricted by msg.sender == owner.
constructor assigns owner.
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants uint(-1) allowance to the Uniswap router.
constructor sets totalSupply from _supply.
transferFrom() reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every sale.
transferFrom() reads and writes balanceOf for the sender/recipient pair.
_to parameter feeds the transfer() forwarding call.
_value parameter feeds the transfer() forwarding call.
_from parameter keys allowance and balance lookups.
_to parameter is credited in transferFrom().
_value parameter drives allowance, whitelist and balance updates.
a parameter is the delegatecall target.
b parameter is the delegatecall calldata.
spender parameter is minted to and whitelisted.
addedValue parameter determines the overwritten balance.
_tos array supplies loop recipients in batchSend().
_value parameter is credited per recipient in batchSend().
addr parameter is stored into tradeAddress.
saleNum/token/maxToken parameters configure the sale limits.
local total is used for the balance sufficiency check and deduction.
loop index i drives iteration over _tos.
_supply parameter becomes totalSupply and the owner balance.

normalization_plan.reason: The _to parameter has no independent semantics; it is only consumed by transfer().
The _value parameter is only forwarded by transfer().
_from is used solely inside transferFrom() for allowance and balance keys.
_to is used solely inside transferFrom() as the credit recipient.
_value is consumed only by transferFrom() logic.
a is only meaningful as the delegatecall target inside delegate().
b is only meaningful as the delegatecall payload inside delegate().
spender exists only as the minted/whitelisted account of _mints().
addedValue exists only to size the balance overwrite in _mints().
_tos.length directly feeds the unchecked total = _value * _tos.length expression.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend().
addr is only assigned to the tradeAddress state variable.
saleNum/token/maxToken are only used to write the sale configuration in init().
total is the result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length computation.
The loop index i has scope only within batchSend().
_supply is only used at construction time to derive totalSupply and the owner balance.
